featured_reviews.name: Sameer Mokashi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Testimonial from Sameer Mokashi

My daughter, Varnika has an inclination for drawing and I was looking for an art teacher who could introduce her to some sketching and painting techniques. After looking for about 3-4 months I stumbled upon ‘I can paint anything’. They scheduled a zoom meeting. Poonam ma’am spent a good one and half hours running us through a nice presentation and talking not only about our immediate requirement but about the discipline and profession of art in general. It was a lot to take in, but very interesting and promising.

As Varnika spent time on her drawing classes and practice, I could see some visible improvements very quickly. There emerged some structure to her practice. During the class, the importance of basic lines and curves was stressed along with the significant elements such as shape, texture and value among others. Due to these lessons her ‘still life’ drawings both in pencil and crayons improved dramatically. I had never imagined that crayons could be used so effectively. Her improved sense of light effects reflected in her regular homework. Poonam ma’am regularly spent more than the official class hours and did not move on to the next topic until her student really got a hang of the technique she was teaching. We were also lucky to get free lessons in landscape painting which was not part of this course.

As was promised in the initial presentation and we did end up at the right place for learning art. What Varnika has gained from Poonam ma’am within the space of less than 3 months is beyond my expectations – I would have gladly settled for half of this. I wish Poonam ma’am the best in her mission and growth in her art career.

Sameer Mokashi - father of Varnika Mokashi
